positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Scoped, architected and implemented a code generator that expedited the process of building API connections, reducing the average implementation time from 6 weeks to 2 weeks, resulting in accelerated project deliveries
● Collaborated with multiple teams to implement support for tax and bank statements by seamlessly connecting to multiple bank endpoints and integrating with AWS S3 for PDF encryption and storage
● Engineered robust secure OAuth API integrations with multiple bank systems, ensuring secure and reliable communication for financial transactions and data retrieval
● Mentored and coached junior engineers on industry best practices and efficient methodologies for API connectivity, enhancing their technical skills and fostering increased productivity within the team
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · ActiveRecord · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Spearheaded the development of a comprehensive RSpec test suite from scratch for a legacy application, resulting in enhanced deployment safety and a deeper comprehension of the application's functionality
● Successfully resolved multiple security vulnerabilities on a legacy application, including safeguarding against SQL-injection attacks, CSRF attacks, and unvalidated redirects, fortifying the application's security against potential threats.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · ActiveRecord · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Increased company efficiency by creating a “company-wizard” that hooked up API endpoints to give employees and customers information from other company applications
● Developed strategies to manipulate and transform terabytes of medical PII data from different sources to be encrypted and stored properly into Elasticsearch
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · ActiveRecord · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
Nuvi was a great learning experience because they always keep up with the latest tech. While interning I learned a lot of different skills and technologies such as:

Golang, Ruby, RabbitMQ, HTML, CSS, Postgres, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Grafana, Selenium, StatsD and Redis.

Working 40+ hours a week, I wrote code primarily in Go and spent most of my time processing large data using ETL. I built numerous converters that would transform JSON payloads to usable data/information that was submitted and processed into the production environment. The data comes from several social media API's including Twitter, Youtube, Facebook, Tumblr, Pinterest and many more.
